_comment: Variant adapter table for the Hermes host: all three tiers on one paid OpenRouter model. Selected per run with the HERMES_ADAPTER_TABLE environment variable (a bare file name in this directory); hermes.json stays the default. Because the provider is paid, the effort policy applies in full: xhigh ceiling, max and ultra forbidden (see effort-policy.test.mjs). The roles and seats repeat hermes.json on purpose, since each table must stand alone; a test guards against drift.
description: Hermes adapter, paid-API variant. Spawns each seat as a `hermes -z` subprocess on Kimi K3.1 Pro via OpenRouter, pinning model, provider, effort, and tool surface per seat.
_fallback_comment: Within-tier fallback, same mechanism as hermes.json. The fallback inherits the tier effort.
_seats_comment: The tool surface per seat, passed to `hermes -t`. Same as hermes.json: no seat gets the `delegation` toolset (flat-star invariant), and seats omit memory and session_search.
